translation.name: Las Escrituras en Ashéninka Ucayali del Sur del Perú

content: Tzimae otsipa iina Abraham oeta Cetura
Irika itomipaeni itzimakakirori: Zimram, Jocsán, Medán, Madián, Isbac, Súa.
Riitaki Jocsán tomintanakariri Seba eejatzi Dedán. RiDedán sheninkatariri Asur-paeni, Letus-ite, Leum-paeni
Madián tomintanakariri Efa, Efer, Janoc, Abida, Elda. Maawoeni irikapaeni ri otomipaeni Cetura.
Riima Isaac riitaki aakirori okaatzi tzimimotziriri ashitariri Abraham.

Riima itsipa itomipaeni otzimakiri iinapaeni, apatziro ipakiri eepichokiini tzimimotziriri Abraham. Tekira ikamiita Abraham, rotyaantakiri itomipaeni rinashityaawo inampiteeyawo ishitowapiintzira ooryaa, tee itsipatari Isaac.
Okaatzi 175 ojarentsi rañaaki Abraham.
Kameetha ikamashitaka Abraham aakiri rantyaashiparinka. Ari itsipatapaari isheninkapaeni.
Riitaki kitateeri Isaac itsipatakari Ismael janta omoonaki Macpela-ki omontetari Mamre, iipatsiteki Efrón itomiranki Zoar Het-ite.
Rootaki iipatsite Abraham ramanakiriri paerani Het-ite. Ari ikitataari Abraham itsipatapaawo iinani Sara.
Okanta ikamaki Abraham-ni, itajonkawentakiri Tajorentsi irika Isaac, riitaki nampitaawori janta nijaateniki iiteetziro “Inijaate Añaari Ñaakinari.”
Irika itomipaeni Ismael, itomiranki Abraham itzimakantakawori Agar, Egipto-jato ini onampiri Sara.
Irika ikaatzi tzimaentsiri: Nebaeot, reewarite itomi. Eejatzi Cedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Misma, Dima, Massa,
Jadar, Tema, Jetur, Nafis, Cedema.
Riitaki 12 itomipaeni Ismael. Maawoeni tzimimotziriri iipatsite, rootaki iwaero aakoyitakiri inampi eejatzi iipatsite. Reewayitziri ikaatzira ijeeki inampiki.
Okaataki 137 rojarentsite Ismael roojatzi ikamantaari. Ari itsipatapaari isheninkapaeni.

Inampitaawo itomipaeni niyankithakineki kepatsi ojeekira nampitsi Havila, Sur, imontetakawo nampitsi Egipto, awotsiki jatachari Asiria-ki. Ari inampitakawori, okantawitaka tee ikowaeyini isheninkapaeni.
Irika ikenkithatakoetziri Isaac, itomi Abraham.
Tzimaki Isaac okaatzi 40 rojarentsite, raantakawori iina Rebeca rishinto Betuel, ritsiro Labán, Arampaini rini nampitawori Padan-aram-ki.
Teera itzimi Rebeca eentsite. Rootaki ramanakotantakawori Isaac ikowakotziri Tajorentsi. Ikemakiro ramana Tajorentsi, motzitaki Rebeca.

Okanta omotzitaki Rebeca, okematziiri raatzikatzikaatziro omotziki eentsite, ari okantashiretanaki: “Tzimatsirika awijimotenani, ¿oetaka nañaantyaari?” Jataki amanari Tajorentsi okoyi iyotero oeta anteri.
Rakanakiro Tajorentsi:

content.text: Apite okanta nampitsi, rootaki retantawori ikoshekawakaa tekira itzimiita.
Shintsiri ikantya apaani, riima itsipa tee ishintsitzi,
Riitaki omperatantachani impoerintzi, riitaki rompereetya etawori itzimi.
Okanta omonkaataka otzimaanitantyaari Rebeca, tzimaki tsipantzi.
Etapaakawori itzimi ikityonkatepokitatzi, ithonka iwitzitaki iwathaki, iiteetakiri Esaú.
Roteeyakiri iitziki itsipa rirentzi itzimapaakira, rootaki iitanteetakariri Jacob. Tzimaki Isaac okaatzi 60 rojarentsite otzimanitantakari Rebeca.

content: Ari ikimotatanaki eentsipaeni. Osheki iñaawenatakawo Esaú owaantsi, kominthaantzi rini. Riima Jacob, tekatsi iñaamatya rirori, rashi royiro ijeekawaetzi pankotsiki.
Antawoete retakotakari Isaac itomi Esaú, tema osheki rowakotapiintakari ikentate. Rooma Rebeca etakotane oyiri roori Jacob.
Ikanta ijeeki Jacob ronkotsiwaetzi, ari rareetaari Esaú imakonekiini ipoñahaawo owaantsiki.
Ikantapaakiri: “Pipena eepichokiini poshiñeenkatentsiri ponkotsiri, aatyeena notashe.” (Rootaki iitanteetariri Edom eejatzi irika Esaú.)
Ari ikantanaki Jacob: “Petawakyaawo eeroka poshiyakaeena naakami etyaawoni notzime.”
Eekiro ikantanakitzi Esaú: “Tema pikemana aatyena notashe, tekatsi oetya neewatakira notzimaki.”

Eekiro ishintsitanakitzi Jacob, ikantziri: “Ajatyaa pikantaperotena nimaeka.” Ari ishinetakiniriri Esaú rirentzi Jacob roshiyakaeri riitaki etyaawonimi itzimi, opoñaantyaari rahaero paata maawoeni tzimimotziriri ipaapate.
Ipakiri Jacob rowanawo rirentzi Esaú. Ikanta ithonkakiro rowaka, riranaki imiri. Katziyanaka, jatanee. Tee ikenkithashiretakotero jemperika ikanteetero retawitakawowa itzimaki paerani.

footnotes.text: 25.25 Iroka waerontsi “Esaú”, iñaaniki riroripaeni oshiyawori akantziri aaka “witzintzi.”
25.26 Iroka waerontsi “Jacob”, iñaaniki riroriite oshiyawaetawo akantziri aaka “Patzikontantsi.” Oshiyawaetawo eejatzi akantziri “Iwitaantsi.”
25.30 Iroka waerontsi “Edom”, iñaaniki riroripaeni oshiyawo akantziri aaka “kityonkari.”
